from common import *
import argparse,traceback,resource,gc

def hash_array(a):
    h=hashlib.sha256()
    for i in range(0,len(a),8192):h.update(a[i:i+8192].tobytes(order='C'))
    return h.hexdigest()

def main():
    p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('variant',choices=VARIANTS);p.add_argument('treatment',choices=['new','old']);p.add_argument('seed',type=int);a=p.parse_args()
    assert a.seed in SEEDS
    save_source(__file__);harness('check')
    progress=read(PROGRESS);check(progress['prepared_inputs'])
    assert not any(j['status']=='running' for j in progress['jobs'])
    job=f'{a.variant}-{a.treatment}-s{a.seed}-a1'
    assert not any(j['job_id']==job for j in progress['jobs'])
    harness('event',{'type':'fit_start','exp_id':EID,'job_id':job,'seed':a.seed,'label_horizon':20,'command':[sys.executable,str(Path(__file__)),*sys.argv[1:]]})
    progress['jobs'].append({'job_id':job,'status':'running','phase':'preparing','variant':a.variant,'treatment':a.treatment,'seed':a.seed,'pid':os.getpid(),'started_at':time.time()});write(PROGRESS,progress)
    try:run(a,job)
    except BaseException as e:
        out=BASE/'docs'/f'{job}-failure.json';write(out,{'error':repr(e),'traceback':traceback.format_exc(),'job_id':job})
        progress=read(PROGRESS);progress['jobs'][-1].update(status='failed',finished_at=time.time(),evidence=fingerprint(out));write(PROGRESS,progress)
        harness('event',{'type':'fit_result','job_id':job,'outcome':'failed','evidence':[str(out.relative_to(ROOT))]})
        raise

def run(a,job):
    import numpy as np,pandas as pd,lightgbm as lgb,qlib
    from backtest.scripts.train import train_regime_arm as tr
    from backtest.models import regime_adapt as models
    from backtest.scripts.evaluate import eval_ic_multi_pool as ev
    assert Path(qlib.__file__).resolve().is_relative_to(ROOT)
    qlib.init(provider_uri=str(PROVIDER),region='cn',kernels=1)
    prepared=read(BASE/'configs/prepared-inputs.json');receipt=prepared['variants'][a.variant][a.treatment];assert receipt
    check(receipt);target=pd.read_pickle(ROOT/receipt['path']);fm=read(FEATURE);parts=[]
    for year in range(2004,2021):
        b=fm['blocks'][str(year)];fp=FEATURE.parent/b['path'];check({**b,'path':str(fp)})
        f=pd.read_pickle(fp);y=target.loc[target.index.get_level_values('datetime').year==year]
        assert y.index.isin(f.index).all()
        x=f.reindex(y.index);x.columns=pd.MultiIndex.from_product([['feature'],f.columns]);x[('label','LABEL0')]=y.to_numpy();parts.append(x)
    train=pd.concat(parts,copy=False);del parts,f,x,y;gc.collect()
    expected=read(PRIOR/'docs/inputs-h20.json');xsha=hash_array(train['feature'].to_numpy())
    assert xsha==expected['feature_array_sha256']
    tsig=tr.frame_signature(train)
    assert tsig['index_sha256']==expected['training']['index_sha256']
    assert np.array_equal(train[('label','LABEL0')].to_numpy(),target.to_numpy())
    vm=read(VALID);vp=VALID.parent/vm['blocks']['frame']['path'];check({**vm['blocks']['frame'],'path':str(vp)})
    cached=pd.read_pickle(vp);valid=cached['frame'];tradable=cached['tradable'];del cached
    valid=valid.loc[valid.index.get_level_values('datetime')<=pd.Timestamp('2026-07-23')];tradable=tradable.reindex(valid.index)
    vsig,msig=tr.frame_signature(valid),tr.frame_signature(tradable)
    assert vsig==expected['valid_signature'] and msig==expected['tradable_signature']
    weights=models.compose_day_weights(train.index,pd.Series(np.ones(len(train))),models.load_day_weights(str(WEIGHTS)))
    inp={'training':tsig,'feature_array_sha256':xsha,'label_values_sha256':hash_array(target.to_numpy()),'label_receipt':receipt,'validation':vsig,'tradable':msig,'weights_sha256':hash_array(weights.to_numpy()),'parameters':read(BASE/'configs/frozen-study.json')['parameters'],'source':fingerprint(BASE/'docs/adapter-train.json')};del weights,target
    inp_path=BASE/'docs'/f'{job}-inputs.json';write(inp_path,inp)
    params=dict(tr.FROZEN_SINGLE_KWARGS);params['early_stopping_rounds']=50
    model=models.RegimeSingleLGBMModel(protocol_id='regime-adapt-v1',valid_dates_csv=None,day_weights_csv=str(WEIGHTS),seed=a.seed,es_metric='top5_h5_net_ann',tradable_mask=tradable,**params)
    curves=[];round_notes=[];original_metric=models.top5_h5_net_ann;original_train=lgb.train
    eligible=tradable.fillna(False).to_numpy(dtype=bool)&np.isfinite(valid[('label','LABEL0')].to_numpy())
    dates=valid.index.get_level_values('datetime');groups=[pos.to_numpy() for _,pos in pd.Series(np.flatnonzero(eligible),index=dates[eligible]).groupby(level=0)]
    def boundary_counts(pred):
        counts={3:0,5:0}
        for pos in groups:
            if len(pos)<20:continue
            values=pred[pos];top=np.partition(values,len(values)-6)[-6:];top.sort()
            counts[5]+=int(top[0]==top[1]);counts[3]+=int(top[2]==top[3])
        return counts
    def metric(pred,label,index,tradable=None):
        value=original_metric(pred,label,index,tradable)
        ties=boundary_counts(pred)
        reverse=original_metric(pred[::-1],label[::-1],index[::-1],tradable) if ties[5] else value
        round_notes.append({'round':len(round_notes)+1,'top3_boundary_tie_days':ties[3],'top5_boundary_tie_days':ties[5],'reverse_priority_score':reverse})
        return value
    def observer(env):
        tree=env.model.dump_model(start_iteration=env.iteration,num_iteration=1)['tree_info'][0]
        curves.append({'round':env.iteration+1,'objective':float(env.evaluation_result_list[0][2]),'tree_sha256':hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(tree,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')).encode()).hexdigest()})
    observer.order=25;observer.before_iteration=False
    def observed_train(*args,**kw):
        kw['callbacks']=[*kw['callbacks'],observer];return original_train(*args,**kw)
    models.top5_h5_net_ann=metric;lgb.train=observed_train
    state=read(PROGRESS);state['jobs'][-1].update(phase='fitting',fit_started_at=time.time());write(PROGRESS,state)
    print('FIT',job,train.shape,valid.shape,flush=True)
    start=time.time();model.fit_prepared(train,valid);elapsed=time.time()-start
    models.top5_h5_net_ann=original_metric;lgb.train=original_train
    session=f'labelgrade_20261106_{a.variant}_{a.treatment}_s{a.seed}'
    summary={'arm':'m0','model':'single','seed':a.seed,'label_horizon':20,'label_expr':'Ref($close,-21)/Ref($close,-1)-1','label_quantization':a.variant,'label_treatment':a.treatment,'es_metric':'top5_h5_net_ann','es_valid_source':'eval_window','es_label_window_policy':'exit_within_eval_window_h5','rankic_evals':model.rankic_evals_result,'fit_seconds':elapsed,'train_shape':list(train.shape),'frozen_hyperparams':'B3-M single,patience50,graded H20','input_receipt':str(inp_path.relative_to(ROOT))}
    session_dir=tr.save_session('m0',a.seed,session,model,summary,weight_arm='m0')
    meta=read(session_dir/'meta.json');meta.update(provider_uri=str(PROVIDER),owner_experiment=EID,label_grading_job=job);write(session_dir/'meta.json',meta)
    model_path=session_dir/'run_01/artifacts_root/artifacts/trained_model'
    out=BASE/'docs'/f'{job}.json'
    result={'job_id':job,'session':session,'model':fingerprint(model_path),'input_receipt':fingerprint(inp_path),'parameters':model.params,'early_stopping':model.rankic_evals_result,'rounds':curves,'tie_diagnostics':round_notes,'fit_seconds':elapsed,'max_rss_bytes':resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss}
    write(out,result)
    del train;gc.collect()
    pred=pd.Series(model.model.predict(valid['feature'].to_numpy(),num_threads=8),index=valid.index,name='score')
    panel=ev.daily_head_panel(pred,valid[('label','LABEL0')],[3,5],tradable=tradable)
    heads={str(k):{str(d.date()):sorted(v) for d,v in panel[k]['sets'].items()} for k in [3,5]}
    heads_path=BASE/'data'/f'{job}-valid-heads.json';write(heads_path,heads)
    result.update(selected_valid_heads=fingerprint(heads_path),selected_prediction_sha256=hash_array(pred.to_numpy()),selected_boundary_ties=boundary_counts(pred.to_numpy()))
    write(out,result)
    state=read(PROGRESS);state['jobs'][-1].update(status='succeeded',phase='complete',finished_at=time.time(),evidence=fingerprint(out),session=session);write(PROGRESS,state)
    harness('event',{'type':'fit_result','job_id':job,'outcome':'succeeded','evidence':[str(out.relative_to(ROOT)),str(model_path.relative_to(ROOT))]})
    print(json.dumps({'job':job,'best':model.model.best_iteration,'rounds':len(curves),'fit_seconds':elapsed,'peak_GiB':result['max_rss_bytes']/1024**3}),flush=True)

if __name__=='__main__':main()
